name: USMLE
description: United States Medical Licensing Examination questions used as a medical knowledge benchmark. Tests clinical knowledge and reasoning across basic science and clinical medicine. Questions are multiple choice with clinical vignettes.
typical_sota_score: ~90%+ (frontier models easily pass the 60% passing threshold)
reputation: Medical licensing exam used as AI benchmark; GPT-4 famously passed USMLE; key medical AI milestone; used in MedPaLM evaluations
notes: GPT-4 achieved passing scores in early 2023, marking a major milestone for medical AI. MedPaLM 2 achieved expert-level performance (~86%). Now included in MedQA benchmark. Consists of Steps 1, 2, and 3.
